title: DEMO — Community Report: Flooding Near Mohali Sector 70
rawContent:
COMMUNITY REPORT (Unverified)

Location: Near Mohali Sector 70, close to the main market
Time: Around 10:00 AM

There is serious flooding near Sector 70. The water is about 2 feet deep on the main road. I saw two cars stuck. The road going towards Phase 7 side is also very bad.

I also heard from my neighbor that the Airport Road is still open but barely passable. They drove through about 30 minutes ago and said the water was up to the wheel hubs.

Some people in our sector WhatsApp group are saying that the nallah (drain) near Sector 71 is overflowing and water is entering the ground floor of some houses. I haven't verified this myself.

Please be careful if you need to go out.

(SIMULATED COMMUNITY REPORT FOR DEMONSTRATION PURPOSES)
